pages.text: After 30 more seconds of wear at sweat level 3 (default, host-adjustable), you catch $(bold)foot fungus$(). It does NOT go away - taking boots off, pouring sweat or sleeping won't clear it, it stays with you.$(br2)While infected: noticeably slower, sneezing every so often, and possible damage.

$(bold)It can be cured$() - but only one way, and the advancements page might hint at it.$(br2)It is also $(bold)contagious$(): stand too close to an infected player and you may catch it - and the newly infected can spread it further.
